# MuchoCore

> MuchoCore is an open-source PHP 8.3+ Geometry Dash Private Server (GDPS) core for hosting, migrating, securing, and operating self-hosted Geometry Dash private servers.

## Canonical identity

- Project name: MuchoCore
- Repository: https://github.com/IZKGMD/GMDmucho-core
- Repository path: IZKGMD/GMDmucho-core
- Current stable release: v1.0.8
- Official product page: https://muchogdps.space/muchocore/
- Primary language: PHP
- Database: MariaDB / MySQL-compatible SQL
- Deployment: Docker Compose, Caddy, Linux/VPS
- Protocol scope: Geometry Dash client generations 1.0 through 2.2
- Security layer: MuchoProtect

## What the project provides

MuchoCore is a complete GDPS backend and server core. It includes accounts, profiles, levels, scores, comments, social features, ratings, rewards, cloud save, clans, moderation, JSON API v2, Cvolton-style migration tooling, Admin RBAC, client patchers, rate limiting, backups, diagnostics, plugins, indexed search, caching, level revisions, background jobs, signed webhooks, and protocol compatibility profiles.
